title: Linearization Problem for Third-Order ODEs with Four- and Five-Dimensional Lie Symmetry Algebras under Contact Transformations
summary: Using Cartan equivalence method, invariant coframes are constructed for two branches of rank one and zero, which characterize linearizable third-order ODEs under contact transformations with four- and five-dimensional Lie symmetry algebras, respectively. A procedure for deriving the corresponding contact transformations is also presented, along with illustrative examples.
